title: Split provider registry built-ins, factory dispatch types, and capability lookup helpers
description: ProviderRegistry is behaviorally stable but still combines built-in registration, factory type aliases, metadata lookup, duplicate checks, and per-capability build errors in one module.

files.change: Keep public ProviderRegistry imports stable while moving built-in registration and shared factory/error helpers into focused modules.
Add builtins, factories, metadata, and errors modules if the split remains behavior-preserving.

criteria: ProviderRegistry remains the public provider adapter entry point.
Built-in provider registration is deterministic and independently testable.
No concrete provider payload or runtime config mapping moves into the registry.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo clippy -p astrbot-provider -- -D warnings
